name: Urco
descr: A black-furred hound from beyond the veil of death that portends death and feeds on fear.

features.name: Fearmonger
features.text: When a PC within Very Close range fails with Hope, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Terror-Fueled
features.text: The Urco gains a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Fear you have.

features.name: Fear Eater
features.text: **Spend any number of Fear** to clear the same number of Stress. If the Urco has no marked Stress, you can **spend any number of Fear** to clear the same number of HP.

features.name: Baleful Gaze
features.text: When the Urco takes damage from an attack, you can **spend a Fear** to cause the attacker's damage thresholds to gain a -1 penalty until the end of the scene. This effect can stack.
